releases.body:
### Security fix

- **The launcher no longer takes control commands from other apps** ([#7](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/issues/7)).
  - Before this release, any app on the phone could ask Anka Native's launcher to install or pick a GPU driver, add a game, start Prepare, or export or import a pack. These are commands meant for testing over adb.
  - The app now ignores them and shows a short message, unless you turn on **Settings › ADB control (debug)**. That switch is off by default and asks before it turns on. Turn it on only while you use adb.
  - Starting a game from a frontend works as before.

Everything else is as in [0.2.1](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/releases/tag/v0.2.1). The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md](https://github.com/EddizEge/AnkaNative/blob/main/CHANGELOG_ANKA_NATIVE.md).

releases.body:
**Prepare on the phone (experimental).** The app can now make a game's pack from your dump on the phone itself. You no longer need a computer.

### How

Copy your dump (or `.nup`) to the phone, open **Anka Native**, tap **Add game**, pick the dump and tap **Prepare**. The app does three things in the background, with a notification:

1. It rewrites the game's code.
2. It scans the game's files for shaders.
3. It translates the shaders.

When it is done, the game's card says Ready.

- **Keep the phone on a charger.** For Ocarina of Time, preparing takes about 3 hours and uses the CPU fully.
- If a step fails, the card says why. Its log is in `<title ID>-work/ondevice/logs` next to the dump. Preparing on a computer still works as before.

On a POCO F8 Pro with Ocarina of Time:

- **Code rewrite:** worked, about 3 minutes.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz

releases.name: GenX v1.1.3
releases.body:
Play your real Sega CD discs. Nothing else in the emulation changed.

**Download:** `GenX-v1.1.3-win64.zip`. Unzip it anywhere and run `genx.exe`.
To update, replace your old `genx.exe` with the new one. Your settings and
saves stay where they are.

### New

- **Sega CD discs straight from your PC's CD/DVD drive.** Put the disc in,
  choose **File → Open ROM → Sega CD from drive**, and pick the drive. GenX
  reads the game and its CD music from the disc, reading ahead while you play
  so the drive keeps up. A USB drive works too.
- **Changing discs:** use **Sega CD → Swap to disc in drive**, or just put the
  next disc in the drive. GenX swaps it in as a real Sega CD would.
- **Front ends:** `genx.exe E:\` starts the disc in drive E:.

You still need the Sega CD BIOS for the disc's region.

If your drive or a disc doesn't work, please
[open an issue](https://github.com/GamesExObscura/GenX/issues) with the drive's
make and model and the game.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/GamesExObscura/GenX/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
for every change.

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the exe isn't code-signed.
Choose **More info → Run anyway**.

**Fixed: "POM2 is damaged" on macOS.** An accented file name in the package
broke the app's signature when the Finder copied it into *Applications*. macOS
then called the app damaged and offered no way to allow it from System Settings.

The emulator itself is unchanged from
[v1.1.0](https://github.com/habib256/pom2/releases/tag/v1.1.0), which has the
full list of new features. v1.1.1 was tagged but never published.

releases.body:
**New hardware.** Eight cards — Microsoft SoftCard II, PCPI Applicard,
Premium SoftCard //e, ALS CP/M Card, Saturn 128K, Videx UltraTerm, DAN ][

track losing one transition per revolution, a same-value 6522 store that
re-strobed the AY, five ImageWriter power-on defaults. Where POM2's reading
of a datasheet differs from another emulator's, the divergence is now
documented in the code rather than silently aligned. Every hardware claim
carries its **evidence

> 这一版完成“连接与重连”：Android 不用再手动输入 IP，可以从附近设备列表或扫码连接电脑；电脑换了地址后，Android 点“连接”会自动找到新地址重连。

## 新功能

- **局域网发现**：电脑端服务运行时在局域网广播本机，Android 设备页的“附近”列表会列出同一网络中的电脑，点一下即可连接。
- **扫码连接**：电脑端设备页显示连接二维码，Android 扫码即可连接。二维码带多个候选地址，推荐地址不可用时会依次尝试其他地址；深色主题下二维码随主题变色。
- **设备页重新设计（两端）**：电脑端显示服务卡片、二维码和推荐地址，推荐地址优先取物理网卡上有默认网关的地址；已保存的设备按最近连接排序，在附近的设备会标出来。
- **换地址后自动重连**：电脑因 DHCP 或换网络改了 IP、端口时，Android 点已保存设备的“连接”，会在连接原地址的同时在后台按设备 ID 查找这台电脑；原地址连不上就自动连接新地址并更新保存的地址，游戏和目录设置都保留。
- **界面用语**：两端改用“本机”“对方设备”或设备名称来称呼双方，不再按“电脑”“移动端”区分。

## 修复与改进

- 修正 Windows Portable 包缺少模块、无法启动的问题。
- 电脑端只显示按默认网关和路由优先级推荐的 IPv4 地址，不再列出虚拟网卡等无关地址。
- 对方设备异常断开（如电脑端停止服务）后立即点“连接”，不再提示“正在执行其他任务”。
- 设备页加载图标与文字对齐，标“在附近”的行与其他行等高。
- 开屏动画立绘更新，适配平板等大屏设备。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.0，存档、设备和游戏设置都会保留。
- 两端请一起升级：0.3.0 的电脑端不会广播，Android 的“附近”列表搜不到它，二维码也需要新版电脑端显示。

## 已知限制

- 发现依赖局域网组播（mDNS，UDP 5353）。路由器开启 AP 隔离、访客网络或屏蔽组播时搜不到设备，需用扫码或手动输入地址连接。
- Windows 首次运行时可能弹出防火墙提示，需要允许专用网络访问，否则 Android 无法连接电脑。
- 对方地址没有回应时（例如防火墙丢弃请求），连接约 5 秒后才提示失败。
- 扫码需要授予 Android 相机权限。
- Windows Portable 版和 APK 未经商店分发，首次运行时系统可能提示来源未知。

* * *

> [!NOTE]
> This release completes “connection and reconnection”: Android no longer needs to enter an IP manually—it can connect to the computer from the nearby devices list or by scanning a QR code. If the computer’s address changes, tapping “Connect” on Android automatically finds the new address and reconnects.

## New Features

- **LAN discovery**: When the desktop service is running, it broadcasts itself on the local network. The “Nearby” list on the Android Devices page shows computers on the same network; tap one to connect.
- **QR code connection**: The Devices page on the desktop shows a connection QR code, which Android can scan to connect. The QR code contains multiple candidate addresses and tries the others in order if the recommended address is unavailable. In dark theme, the QR code changes color with the theme.

> **Android 务必先卸载旧版再安装。** 0.3.0 的备份位置和格式都变了，不再读取旧备份。

- 两端统一返回规则：返回到进入当前页之前的页面；传输详情返回游戏页。Android 返回键逐级返回，最后退出。

- 移动端页面铺满系统栏，状态栏和页面背景连成一片，弹层遮罩也能盖住状态栏。
- 错误提示尽量写明出错的是电脑还是移动端。

- 电脑端去掉窗口菜单栏，默认菜单附带的 Ctrl+R、Ctrl+Shift+I 等快捷键也随之取消；同时去掉侧栏菜单多余的竖线。

- 修复移动端文件夹改名后，所有操作都报“读写文件失败”，重新选择目录也存不进去的问题。
- 修复移动端点“断开”时偶发卡死，只能重启应用的问题。
- 修复连续翻转方向、扫描中离开再进入、传输刚完成就重新扫描时，比较报“正在执行其他任务”的问题。

- 修复传输计划放置超过 10 分钟再开始时报“找不到”，重试和返回都无法恢复的问题。

## 改进

- 两端改用 Websocket 连接。电脑浏览手机目录、发起传输都不用再等，手机目录打开就显示，不用手动刷新。
- 在电脑上修改游戏配置后，手机会马上同步更新。
- 手机关闭应用或断开连接时，电脑会立即提示。如果这时传输已经开始，会提示到任务列表查看结果。

## 修复

- 手机传输详情里，同一个文件的结果会重复出现，切换到其他页面后还会残留。

releases.body:
## Added NetPlay Public Rooms

Until now, NetPlay worked over the internet with no account, no relay, and no service to trust. The one thing it could not do was find you an opponent: you still had to know someone already, and swap an IP address with them by hand.

**Public Rooms** is that missing half. It's an optional board where hosts advertise the game they are hosting, so anyone with the same ROM can tap it and connect.

What it is *not* is a relay. The board introduces two players and then steps out of the way — the match still runs directly between the two devices, exactly as it did before, and nothing about it passes through any server of mine. 

### On the board

* **Room codes.** Every room gets a short code you can pass to a friend. 
* **PIN rooms.** Tick *Require PIN* and the room still appears, marked as protected, but only the people you told can get in. The PIN itself never reaches the server — only a hash of it does.
* **A color-coded connection forecast.** Green, amber, or red per room, based on what STUN actually measured about both routers rather than a guess. Two symmetric NATs with no way through show red and refuse the join.
* **Same-network rooms are flagged**

It also introduces the "setups" concept, which enables you to define an MSX setup (e.g. a Philips VG 8020 with an external disk drive and a joystick, data recorder and printer connected). releases.body:
Another year has gone by, therefore we are releasing a new ScummVM version. As you may notice right away, we are changing our version numbering schema, but that’s not all! We are also planning on more frequent releases!, which you can read about on [sev’s blog](https://www.patreon.com/posts/new-milestone-in-149535385).

This could be the biggest release we have made so far in terms of the added features and engines. If I count correctly, we have added 12 new engines to our compatibility page. Not games, engines. In terms of games, it is challenging to count, since two of the engines, SLUDGE and WAGE are authoring tools, but if you count games in our detection tables, that adds up to at least 194 titles!

## Hollow Knight: Silksong Android 2.0.0

**Note when updating from a previous version**: This will trigger the porting process again, but it is heavily cached, so should only take a few minutes.

This is a major release for this project, where the biggest change is that we have completely redesigned the bottom screen UI to feel more native to Silksongs design language. Thanks to Kaz Kirigiri for doing most of the design work and providing sketches for this revamped UI!

## Changes since 1.1.0

### Completely revamped bottom screen UI

- All tabs have been revamped to follow the in-game menu as close as possible

- Smoothly animated item selection, tab switching, etc

## Changes since 2.0.0-rc1

### Dual screen

  - Equipping and unequipping tools is animated: the tool flies

releases.body:
The first release of Odin.

Odin (ᚨ) is a low-level emulator of the SEGA Hikaru arcade board. It runs the programs of the real chips wherever they are known, and draws with OpenGL or Vulkan. It is a hard fork of Valkyrie, by Stefano Teso.

## Games

All six Hikaru games, two of them in two versions:

- Air Trix (`airtrix`, `airtrixo`)
- Brave Firefighters (`braveff`)
- Planet Harriers (`pharrier`)
- NASCAR Arcade (`sgnascar`, `sgnascaro`)
- Star Wars Racer Arcade (`swracer`)
- Cyber Troopers Virtual-On Force (`von4`)

They play with a keyboard, mice, gamepads, wheels with force feedback (NASCAR) or light guns (Brave Firefighters). Each game is a MAME ROM and needs the BIOS `hikaru.zip` and `mie.zip` too.

Close the game and back up the complete save set (your saves folder), not only the GDD. Keep the GDD, its recovery and snapshot directories, and the `course-*` files together.

releases.name: G-Diffuser 1.2.0 - The Big Upgrade Edition
releases.body:
1.2.0 brings G-Diffuser to macOS and Android, adds an in-game updater, and is the biggest Course Edit update so far: Mouse Controls, undo, forks, lava strips from F-Zero GX, Magnet strips for the original F-Zero, and Blender-style camera controls. Thanks to everyone in the feature requests channel who shaped it.

## Before you update

- **Coming from 1.1.0, download this release by hand.** 1.1.0 has no updater. From 1.2 on, desktop builds can update themselves.
- **To install by hand,** extract the release over your existing `G-Diffuser` folder. Your `saves/`, ROM and game data stay where they are.
- **Rebuild your ROM hack archives.** Hacks now carry more of their own data, and an archive built by an older version doesn't have it.
- **Continue Cup is per hack.** An existing `gp_resume.bin` stays with the stock game, and each hack starts with no saved cup.
- **Courses that use new features need 1.2.** Forks, magnet traps, custom music and custom elements are ignored or lost on older versions.

## New platforms

- **macOS (Apple Silicon)**, on Metal, for macOS 11 or newer. Tested on an M1. The build isn't signed, so allow the first launch under System Settings > Privacy & Security.
